test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the statements.

Statements:

Some trees are blue.

All blue is green.

Conclusions:

(I) All trees are blue.

(II) Some trees are green.
solution:
Given Statements:

Some trees are blue.

All blue is green.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc301b6c9281fc052e2a525ef885bffc17efbc76f1eca8c7179dcacab41d9e2a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/838c60b61146f855857ef70bb676ca20230ead68d7317a8ae80d2ef4cdcfe5bb.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All trees are blue - **False** (Because, the statement "Some trees are blue" indicates that only a portion of trees are blue. It does not imply that all trees belong to the category of blue. There could be trees that are not blue.)

II. Some trees are green - **True** (Because, the statement "All blue is green" means that the entire category of 'blue' is contained within the category of 'green'. Since there are some trees that are blue, those trees that fall in the overlapping region between 'trees' and 'blue' must also fall within the 'green' category. Therefore, some trees are necessarily green.)

So, **Only conclusion II follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4."**
